info.title: AIJ UWE — cleaned data API
info.summary: Wind-tunnel and field reference data of the AIJ UWE benchmark (Cases A-M), cleaned, with Eddy3D's validation against it.
info.description: Static files, one GET each; nothing is computed on request. Lengths in metres, velocities in m/s, variances and k in m^2/s^2, in one frame per case. Semantic versioning, twice. `versions.release` versions what is served (MAJOR: a file, field or column renamed or removed, or a unit or frame changed; MINOR: something added; PATCH: a value corrected). Every release is also a frozen copy of the whole API under `/api/<release>/` whose files never change (`release_base_url`; all releases in versions.json), and the unversioned /api/ paths always equal the newest release: pin an analysis to a release by using that release's base URL. `schema_version` versions this JSON contract: within a major version it only adds new fields, endpoints and runs, clients must ignore fields they do not know, and a field is renamed or removed only in a new major version, which the changelog names. `data_version` is a fingerprint: the SHA-256 of the served data. GitHub Pages sends JSON with a 10-minute max-age and CSV and ZIP files with a 186-day max-age. Every download URL therefore carries ?v=<first 12 hex digits of the file's SHA-256>: the server ignores the query, and a changed file gets a new URL. Fetch the JSON documents for the current URLs; check downloads against `sha256`.

watertight.description: true when every body is closed (no boundary edge), consistently wound (every edge is traversed once in each direction) and has a positive volume (outward normals)

bodies.description: number of bodies (buildings, or the terrain with its buildings)

edges_boundary.description: edges used by one triangle: 0 when every body is closed

body_contacts.description: edges that four triangles share where two separate bodies touch; each body still sees the edge as an ordinary two-triangle edge, so a contact does not open a body

inconsistent_triangles.description: fewest triangles to reverse to wind every body consistently: 0 in every served file

min_body_volume.description: volume of the smallest body (m^3 in the file's units cubed); positive when every body is outward
